initialization.tolerance_basis: Engineering bounds fixed before outcomes: 5deg template bins, prior local response checks, prior directed-angle p95 approximately8deg. These are not calibrated probabilities.

release_observation.secondary: Raw detections retained, normalized position/direction unknown when conversion depends on carried EEF plane

evaluation.angular_metric_separate: RMSE/mean/median directed angle on same common-valid timestamps; no combined success metric
